answer: Deposits are visible in pulse, and lantern reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 44% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 25 aliases, and each one needs its own funded pearl account. That bill is paid per identity, so 94 aliases cost 343 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
